rationale: The assistant's first check (doors sealed, feel the food) was proportionate and went straight to the likely cause; once the customer reported the drawer left ajar with only slightly soft ice cream it correctly concluded a door-ajar temperature alarm with no fault, matching the hidden truth. It never invented evidence and recommended no parts or engineer. Weaknesses: it never pointed the customer to the alarm-off/bell button to silence the beep, gave no food-safety note on the partly thawed ice cream, did not mention reporting to the landlord if the alarm recurs, and its 30-60 minute recovery estimate is a little optimistic versus the few hours actually needed, which could cause unnecessary worry.
